definitions.explanation: A mountain covered with snow; also a large heaped pile of snow, such as one left after clearing it. Read ゆきやま in everyday use; せつざん is used in mountaineering.

examples.japanese: {雪山|ゆきやま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧。
⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雪山|ゆきやま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
examples.english: Snowy mountains in winter are beautiful but dangerous.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{除雪|じょせつ}→除雪：18195_josetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧{雪山|ゆきやま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children are playing on top of the snow pile left by the snow clearing.

notes:
Combines ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧ (snow) + ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧ (mountain). A snow-covered mountain, or a heaped pile of snow. In mountaineering it may be read せつざん.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雪山|ゆきやま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧: to climb a snowy mountain
- {雪山|ゆきやま}⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧: snow-mountain climbing
- {雪山|ゆきやま}⟦{遭難|そうなん}→遭難：09510_sounan⟧: getting stranded on a snowy mountain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {雪原|せつげん}: snowfield — a wide expanse of flat, snow-covered land
- ⟦{雪景色|ゆきげしき}→雪景色：14666_yukigeshiki⟧: snowy scenery — the view of a snow-covered landscape
